items.title: Cloudflare released open decision models
items.oneliner: Open-weight decision model beats larger LLMs on domain classification with 2.2 second latency and local fine-tuning support.

items.title: SvelteKit 3 is ready
items.oneliner: Framework upgrade adds stronger type safety and a migration command that rewrites common breaking changes for existing apps.

items.title: Audionaut edits multitrack audio locally
items.oneliner: Cross-platform open-source audio editor handles multitrack projects, playlists, and AI automation without a heavyweight DAW workflow.

items.title: Debian dual WAN router walkthrough
items.oneliner: Step-by-step guide shows how to replace a Cisco dual WAN router with Debian 13, VLANs, PPPoE, and failover.

items.title: Outis fakes bounce responses
items.oneliner: CLI tool generates RFC 3464 compliant bounce emails to poison spam sender lists with user unknown responses.

items.title: SequenceHash simplifies secure multihashing
items.oneliner: Trail of Bits published Rust, Go, and Python implementations for safer multihash encoding with test vectors included.

items.title: Company retrieval benchmark is public
items.oneliner: Benchmark compares retrieval methods on messy internal docs, chats, and tickets so teams can choose RAG systems empirically.

items.title: Linux boots on Apple M4
items.oneliner: Deep technical writeup shows the patches, boot flow, and hypervisor changes needed to bring Linux up on M4.

items.title: Readable regex DSL for TypeScript
items.oneliner: Tutorial shows a tree-structured regex DSL for JavaScript and TypeScript that removes escaping pain and clarifies groups.

items.title: React status orbs are open source
items.oneliner: Installable React component library adds animated thinking, searching, and compacting indicators for AI product interfaces.
